app.q: Do my guests need to download an app?
app.a: No. Guests scan the QR code with their phone camera and upload from the browser. No app, no account and no password.

how.q: How do guests get the link?
how.a: Print the QR code on table cards or a sign (we provide ready-made templates), or share the link by message or email.

privacy.a: Only you, plus guests who have your link if you turn on the shared gallery. Galleries are never public or listed on search engines, and we store everything in the EU.

quality.a: No. Originals are stored in full quality and you can download all of them as a ZIP. Guests only ever see smaller previews.

video.a: Yes, on Standard (up to 2 minutes per video) and Premium (up to 5 minutes). The free plan is photos only.

limits.q: What happens when the album is full?
limits.a: Guests see a friendly message and you get a one-click upgrade. Nothing that was already uploaded is lost.

duration.q: How long are my photos kept?
duration.a: 7 days on Free, 12 months on Standard and 24 months on Premium. We remind you by email well before anything is deleted.

refund.q: What if it's not right for me?
refund.a: If your album hasn't been used, you get your money back within 14 days, no questions asked.

finalCta.title: Don't miss a single moment of your day
finalCta.body: Create your event in a minute. Your guests will take care of the rest.
finalCta.note: Free for up to 25 photos · No credit card needed

footer.tagline: Every guest's photos and videos, in one private album, with one QR code.
